Dear Madam,

[I](../persons.html#379) have today paid to your credit with [Hoare & Co](../others.html#169) - £200 – as arranged for the [“Dove”](../books.html#62).

[Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939) has just left, and he asked me to say that a copy has been today sent to [Lt.

Col.

Hall](../persons.html#2429). I am glad to say that we have had a very good start

Yours faithfully

Geo Lillie [Craik](../persons.html#379)

Miss Yonge
